_comment: Authored enemy taunt lines, one list per reason the fight started.
These are the game's real taunt content, written by hand rather than
generated at runtime: they are short, the player hears them constantly,
and a weak clause has nowhere to hide. Edit freely -- this file is data,
and nothing here needs a code change.
Rules: one line each, under about 18 words, spoken aloud mid-fight.
The speaker never knows the pilot's name.
Lines are re-validated on load, so a malformed one is dropped, not spoken.

lines: I know I must have pissed off someone. Mind telling me who, before you kill me?
The price on my head can't be enough for you to put your life at risk.
So that's what I'm worth this season.
Somebody put a price on me. I hope it was embarrassing.
Whatever they paid you, it wasn't enough for this part.
Hope the fee clears before your funeral.
You came a long way for someone else's grudge.
Bounty work... Very honest... Very brave.

lines.text: Somebody's paying you to be here... Nobody's paying me.

lines: You don't even know my name. Just my price.
Must be nice, having someone else decide who you hate.
Do you ask what they did, or just where they are?
I'd ask who wants me dead, but you wouldn't know either.
Somebody I've never met decided this. You're just the delivery.
Funny thing is, I probably shook their hand once.
You picked the wrong head to cash in.
Collect carefully. I'm told I'm difficult.
Let's find out if the price was fair.
You'll earn this one... That's the last favour I can do you.
Come on then. Earn it.
Get on with it, then.
You should have brought help.
This is going to cost you more than they paid.
You just gave me a second reason to kill you today.
Merely a flesh wound. My turn!
If you thought that shot was good, wait till you see mine!
Saved me the trouble of the approach.
That was my shot!... You took my shot!
I was already on my way. You just made it rude.
Ten more seconds and I'd have started it properly.
You've only changed the order of events.
Eager. I like that in a wreck.
Good instincts. Shame about everything else.
Well spotted. Not that it helps.
You saw it coming. Most don't.
Faster than I expected. Not faster than this.
Was that meant to settle it?
You're going to need the next one to be better.
Bold. Let's see how bold lasts.
Everyone gets one. That was yours.
First shot's free. The rest aren't.
Now we're both committed. How nice.
You've saved us both a conversation.
I'd have offered terms. You've saved me the trouble.
My turn.
That all?
What the hell? Your ass just shot the wrong guy!
I don't know why you pulled that trigger, but I do know you are going to regret it.
You better have a good apology and a drink waiting, or your ass is going to die today.
This is my first job after a week off.
My shift ends in twelve minutes. Twelve!
I'm hauling coolant. Coolant! What did you think was in here?
Forty minutes from home and you do this.
I had one delivery left. One.
I was eating. You made me put down a sandwich for this.
I don't even know you. That's the insulting part.
Was it something I flew?
Do I look like someone? Because I think you've got the wrong someone.
There's no cargo, no bounty, no reason. What is wrong with you?
You want to tell me what I did? I'd genuinely like to know.
No warning, no reason. Fine. Same to you.
You picked the wrong quiet afternoon.
I wasn't anybody's problem until about four seconds ago.
Congratulations. You've made this personal for both of us.
I was having a perfectly boring day.
When I file this report... You are going to be in so much trouble!
Whatever you thought this was, you were wrong.
You've just made a very expensive mistake.
Are you serious right now?
Right. So that's how today's going.
I'm going to make this one hurt.
Mining without a permit... Don't take this personally. I'm just doing my job.
No permit, no rocks. Sorry!
I don't write the rules, I just enforce them.
Unlicensed extraction. That's a citation and a beat down.
This is the escalation step. There were earlier ones. You missed them.
The rules say I can destroy your ship for ore poaching... I like the rules!
Compliance would have been faster... It usually is.
Mining without a permit. I didn't make the rules, argue with the guys who did.
Ore poaching... Do you know how rarely I get to use the cannons?
I've been waiting all shift for someone to do something this stupid.
You mined a belt that wasn't yours. Now I get to mine you.
Do you know what the penalty for ore poaching is?... Me... I'm the penalty.
You've committed four violations. I intend to enjoy all four.
I get a bonus for this. Not a big one... Big enough.
Every rock you pulled out of there is a separate charge. I counted.
That belt is licensed to people who paid. You are not people who paid.
Poaching ore from a licensed claim. Bold, and very illegal.
Permit fees exist so I don't have to do this. I don't mind either way.
I did all the paperwork before I even got here. So now I can just enjoy doing this!
I've read the regulations twice. Both times they said I could do this.
You can make this quick, or you can make this thorough.
Cut your engines. It'll read better in the report.
You are going to need a lawyer... Only problem is... there isn't one out here.
Stand down... Now!
You hurt one of ours. Now we're going to hurt you.
Um... That was my friend you just shot!
If you ever blow someone up again, you should probably check if he has friends first.
You made a mess. We're the cleanup.
The first crew underestimated you. We read their file.
They sent the cheap crew first. I'm not the cheap crew.
They called it in before they stopped transmitting.
You got through them... We're not them.
Whatever worked last time won't. We watched.
You let them send a very detailed distress call. Thank you for that.
Ew. I just saw what's left of them.
There wasn't much to recover. You're thorough, I'll give you that.
I've got their last transmission on loop. Want to hear it?
We're the ones who tell their families. Thought you should know that.
Someone had to go collect the pieces. That was me.
No rush. You're not going anywhere.
Take your time. We've got plenty.
There's more of us behind me, but I'd like this one.
You must be tired by now. We're not.
Now it stops being one-sided.
I knew him... Not well... Well enough.
He owed me twenty credits. You've cost me twenty credits.
You should have run.
My turn now.
I've been cleaning up after people like you all week.
Nothing personal, dude. My kids need to eat, and selling your cargo will make that happen.
You are in the wrong place, at the right time. Let's make this fast.
We only need the container. You will have to go.
Everything on your manifest is now on mine.
This is the part where you get lighter.
I've done this four times today. You're the one making it difficult.
Empty it now!... I've got another one of these at four.
I'm not paid enough to chase you. Don't make me.
I'd let you go, but then I'd have to work tomorrow.
Sorry for this!... Rent's due.
Open the hold and we can both be somewhere else in ten minutes.
Cheaper to hand it over. I've run the numbers.
Stop shooting and start unloading.
Pop the clamps and I'll leave your air supply alone.
I'll take the cargo. You can keep the ship, if you're quick.
Move fast and nobody has to explain a body to anyone.
Nice ship. It would be a shame if something happened to the owner.
You want to die over freight?... Really?
Your insurance should cover this... Probably.
I'm going to make this quick... For me.
You've got ten seconds to become cooperative.
Just business. Awful business, but business.
No hard feelings. No feelings at all, really.
My records show you've been a naughty, naughty boy.
These files say you're dirty. Well, I'm the cleaner!
My computer shows you gotta bad rap. Let me fix that for ya.
I don't even know what you did. Somebody said a name and here I am.
Honestly? I'd have let this go. My supervisor wouldn't.
You upset someone who signs my timesheet. That's your problem now.
I didn't pick you. I'm not unhappy about it either.
Your name was on the order before I read it. Saved me a decision.
We keep accounts. Yours came due.
You earned this one slowly.
This isn't about today. Today's just when we found you.
All those little decisions you made? They added up to me.
Do you know how long I've wanted this posting?
We've been waiting for you to stop being a problem.
I drew the short straw. It's the best straw.
Somebody was always going to get to do this. Lucky me.
A lot of people wanted this job. I got in first.
Whatever you did, they don't want you flying after it. Sorry.
There's a word for what you are to us now. It wasn't 'friend'.
You crossed a line. The people on the other side of it have names.
We stopped counting. That's when they sent me.
You know exactly why I'm here.
Long overdue.
Settle up.
I really don't need your shit. I just like to hurt people.
I told my girl I wouldn't hurt anyone today. I'm pretty sure she'll forgive me.
I don't know why you are flying so close. But I can't take any chances.
Who sent you?... Stay back! Stay back!
Don't come any closer. I mean it. I really mean it.
I've had three bad encounters this month. You're not going to be the fourth.
Everyone out here wants something. I'm not waiting to find out what.
Maybe you're nobody. I can't afford maybe.
I always shoot first now. I learned that lesson the hard way.
I don't trust anything with engines. Yours included.
The voices took a vote... Well, you lost.
I don't always know why I do things. I just do them.
Doctor said I should avoid stress. You being here brings me stress.
It's not a good day for me. It's about to be worse for you.

lines.text: Wrong place, wrong day, wrong me?... Mostly the last one.

lines: Don't take it personally. Don't take it any way at all.
Does there have to be a reason?
You'll want an explanation. I don't have one.
Let's get this over with.
I was bored. You'd be amazed what that does to a man out here.
You looked available.
I was in the neighbourhood and you were in it too.
This won't take long.
